name: Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity / Proper Unlabeled Sample Compression
details: The exact bound fails even on a class admitting a proper stable unlabeled scheme: K4 incidence with the empty set has proper queries two and proper unlabeled compression three. This is only a finite strict gap; it does not rule out an affine or functional bound under the finite-compression restriction.
proof_source: Survey Corollary cor:finite-proper-query-counterexample, referencing the database-owned exact value proofs.
witness_verification: The established endpoint values are $Q_{\mathrm{peq}}=2$ and $\mathrm{pUSC}=3$. The latter has a direct all-decoder lower proof and an exact-key-stable width-three upper scheme. Both values are finite; no unbounded-ratio claim is made.
